slides.headline: A forest. Two best friends meet again, after a *betrayal*.
Valentine arrives just in time to stop his best *friend*.
Sylvia, the woman he loves, kneels, still *frightened*.
Valentine holds out his *hand*. Proteus grabs it.
A sword lies dropped in the *grass*.
The page on the left is really Julia, Proteus's *fiancée*.
She holds the *ring* Proteus once gave her.
In the distance, riders are already *coming*.
Hunt painted every leaf outdoors, in a park in *Kent*.
Would you forgive a best friend who betrayed you like *this*?
